title: HASONEFILTER can be TRUE while the column shows no value at all
query: ROW ( "Has One Filter", HASONEFILTER ( Product[Category] ), "Has One Value", HASONEVALUE ( Product[Category] ) ),

source.quote: A column can be filtered without showing any values, -- because of cross-filters
source.supports: the page shows HASONEFILTER true for a category filter combined with a product of another category

source.quote: HASONEVALUE corresponds to the following code: COUNTROWS ( VALUES ( <ColumnName> ) ) = 1

derivation: Lock is an Accessories product, so the two filters together leave no Product row. Product[Category] is directly filtered to one value, Vehicles: HASONEFILTER is TRUE. VALUES ( Product[Category] ) is empty, COUNTROWS of it is BLANK, and BLANK = 1 is FALSE.
